scenario.summary: Attackers use 'ClickFix' lures to trick users into pasting malicious commands into the Windows Run box or terminal, often disguised as CAPTCHA verification steps. These commands initiate a multi-stage attack chain involving Living-off-the-Land binaries like finger.exe for C2, persistence via scheduled tasks and registry keys, and final payloads including infostealers, RATs, and ransomware.

hunt.name: ClickFix Paste-and-Run Execution and Persistence
hunt.description: This hunt identifies ClickFix tradecraft, where social engineering lures trick users into executing code directly from the explorer.exe process (the Run box). It starts with a lead query searching for shell interpreters launched by explorer.exe with suspicious arguments. If confirmed, the hunt opens expensive queries to recover deobfuscated script block content and identifies rare persistence artifacts referencing user-writable paths like AppData. An agent then correlates the interactive paste event with subsequent persistence, specifically looking for sub-minute temporal links between execution and persistence, to reach a verdict.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' AND (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%\\wscript.exe') AND (LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%-enc%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%iex%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%iwr%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%net.webclient%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%invoke-webrequest%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%bypass%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find potential ClickFix pastes by identifying shell interpreters launched directly from the user desktop process with suspicious arguments.
config.expected_signal: Rows naming a host where explorer.exe launched a shell with download or obfuscation flags. Normal administrative shell launches directly from explorer are rare.

nodes.label: Rare scheduled tasks in user paths

config.content: SELECT LOWER(job_cmd_line) AS cmd, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_scheduled_job WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (LOWER(job_cmd_line) LIKE '%\\appdata\\%' OR LOWER(job_cmd_line) LIKE '%\\users\\public\\%' OR LOWER(job_cmd_line) LIKE '%powershell%' OR LOWER(job_cmd_line) LIKE '%-enc%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY LOWER(job_cmd_line) HAVING hosts <= 3 ORDER BY hosts
config.description: Identify scheduled tasks that are unique across the fleet and point to suspicious user-writable paths or PowerShell commands.
config.expected_signal: Tasks seen on very few hosts referencing AppData. A task created shortly after an explorer shell launch is high-fidelity evidence.
